query:
SELECT 
  ar.id,
  ar.wowReportStatus,
  LEFT(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ar.wowReportJson, '$.lifeHistoryPattern')), 500) as lifeHistoryPattern_preview,
  LEFT(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ar.wowReportJson, '$.summary')), 200) as summary_preview
FROM analysis_reports ar
JOIN client_profiles cp ON ar.clientId = cp.id
JOIN users u ON cp.userId = u.id
WHERE u.name LIKE '%Amanda%' OR u.name LIKE '%Lord%'
LIMIT 1;
